claims: Pulse (2025) is a Netflix English-language medical drama.
Pulse (2025) was created by Zoe Robyn.
Pulse (2025) stars Willa Fitzgerald as Danny.
Pulse (2025) stars Colin Woodell as Phillips.
Jessica Rothenberg is in the cast of Pulse (2025).
The first season of Pulse (2025) consists of 10 episodes.
All episodes of the first season of Pulse (2025) were released on April 3, 2025.
Pulse (2025) was canceled after one season.
There is a 2017 Australian drama titled Pulse with 8 episodes.
There is a 2006 film titled Pulse.
